verdict.rationale: Better Auth's evidence shows only client SDK methods (authClient.signUp.email, etc.) and API-level primitives (session, 2FA, organization plugins) — there is no mention of prebuilt UI components or hosted sign-in/sign-up/profile pages anywhere in the docs pack. Community commentary explicitly contrasts it with Clerk as 'more hackable,' implying it is headless rather than shipping ready-made UI.
